target_findings.explanation: At disableTransfers(bool), the checked privileged change restricts the outgoing right of ordinary holders for an otherwise usable request within the recorded domain.

The assessment concerns a common restriction on ordinary outgoing transfers at source offset 1071 under current_authority_required, management_role, transfer_condition. The scoped controller change prevents the same positive outgoing use for ordinary holders without an applicable exempt agent. A committing use and its control direction were checked on the actual ledger.
At zero_fee_transaction(address,address,uint256), the scoped change moves another holder’s existing rights to a separate position without the applicable holder-issued consent.
